# Microsoft Account

> > Centralized account management portal for Microsoft services including Microsoft 365, Family Safety, Windows, Xbox, and security settings.

The Microsoft Account portal serves as the unified hub for managing personal Microsoft services, family safety controls, device settings, subscriptions, and security preferences across Windows, Xbox, Microsoft 365, and mobile platforms.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Family Safety
- Microsoft 365
- Parental controls
- Screen time limits
- Content filtering
- Digital wellbeing
- Child protection
- Device management
- Windows 10
- Windows 11
- Xbox One
- Xbox Series X|S
- Microsoft Edge
- Microsoft Security

## Family Safety & Parental Controls

- [Microsoft Family Safety | Microsoft 365](https://account.microsoft.com/family/about): Microsoft Family Safety parental controls for screen time and content filtering
